sources.deflectionIS: IS 800:2007 5.6.1, Table 6: vertical deflection under the live (imposed) load, and under the wind for purlins, girts and industrial members; a cantilever's limits (span/150 and span/180 for floors, span/120 and span/150 industrial) are those of its double length (cantileverSpan 2). Other buildings: span/300 and span/360; industrial buildings: purlins and girts span/150 and span/180, simple spans span/240 and span/300, rafters span/180 and span/240, gantry girders span/500, 750, 1000. The storey drift and sway limits are BNBC 2020's (the pack this one extends) until covered.
